GeneratedFile.description: A single generated file. The path is relative to the generator's output_dir, and the content is the full file body as a UTF-8 string.

content.description: Full file content as a UTF-8 string. rusl writes this verbatim — no transformations, no trailing newline injection. The plugin is responsible for formatting.

path.description: Relative path within output_dir (e.g. 'types/common.ts', 'models/user.py'). Must not start with '/', must not contain '..' segments, and must not escape output_dir after path resolution. Directory separators use forward slashes on all platforms.

description: The JSON payload a generator plugin writes to stdout. Contains the protocol version and an array of files for rusl to write into the configured output_dir. rusl validates all file paths for safety before writing.

files.description: Array of files to write into the generator's output_dir. All paths are validated by rusl — absolute paths, '..' traversal, and escaping output_dir are rejected. An empty array is valid (the generator produced no output).

version.description: Protocol version. Must match the version from the request.

title: GenerationResponse
